name: authoring-docs-scoped-to-draft-connectors
description: Multi-connector docs lookup: a draft that calls a CRM connector and a mail connector searches the ingested docs of both when fetch_connector_docs gets no connector argument, and every hit names its connector_slug. An explicit `connector` narrows the search to that one connector. With nothing in scope the tool answers connector_scope_required with the resolvable slugs instead of 'no connector in scope'.
failure_class: docs lookup fails with no connector in scope on multi-connector drafts

# CRM billing

## List invoices

GET /invoices returns the open invoice records of a customer with amount and due date.

# Outbound mail

## Send invoice reminder

POST /messages sends an invoice reminder email to one recipient.
